name: pool_format
description: Buffer Pool and Shared Wasm Memory layout definitions for WebDB

constants.name: WASM_STACK_TOP
constants.description: Top of the WASM C stack inside WASM_REGION (0x00C000 = 48 KB).

constants.name: WASM_REGION_SIZE
constants.description: Reserved low region for WASM C stack (48 KB) and .rodata/.data/.bss (16 KB) at 0x000000..0x00FFFF.

constants.name: DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE_BYTES
constants.description: Default cache buffer pool size in bytes (4 MB = 1024 * 4096).

constants.name: DEFAULT_SLOT_COUNT
constants.description: Default number of page cache slots in the buffer pool (1024).

constants.name: MAX_SLOT_COUNT
constants.description: Maximum supported number of page cache slots in the buffer pool (65536 = 256 MB).

constants.name: DEFAULT_PAGE_TO_SLOT_BUCKETS
constants.description: Default number of hash table buckets for page-to-slot mapping (2048, load factor <= 50%).

constants.name: PAGE_TO_SLOT_BUCKET_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes of each hash table bucket (uint32 page_id + uint32 slot_idx = 8 bytes).

constants.name: PAGE_TO_SLOT_SIZE
constants.description: Total size in bytes of the page-to-slot hash table (2048 * 8 = 16 KB).

constants.name: VM_CONTEXT_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for VM execution context state (12 KB).

constants.name: RESULT_BUFFER_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for SQL result row serialization buffer (64 KB).

constants.name: BYTECODE_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for compiled query bytecode instructions (32 KB).

constants.name: PAGE_SCRATCHPAD_SIZE
constants.description: Size in bytes allocated for temporary single-page staging / decompression (4 KB).

constants.name: ALIGNMENT_PADDING_SIZE
constants.description: Padding bytes aligning the start of dynamic page slots to 0x030000 (16 KB).

constants.name: DEFAULT_MAX_QUERY_MEMORY
constants.description: Maximum memory limit in bytes for transient query execution arena (16 MB).

regions.name: WASM_REGION
regions.description: Byte offset 0x000000: WASM C stack (0x000000..0x00BFFF) and .rodata/.data/.bss (0x00C000..0x00FFFF).

regions.name: VM_CONTEXT
regions.description: Byte offset 0x010000: Execution context frames for the SQL VM.

regions.name: RESULT_BUFFER
regions.description: Byte offset 0x013000: Output buffer for query result rows.

regions.name: BYTECODE
regions.description: Byte offset 0x023000: Instruction buffer for compiled bytecode routines.

regions.name: PAGE_SCRATCHPAD
regions.description: Byte offset 0x02B000: Staging buffer for page compression or I/O reassembly.

regions.name: ALIGNMENT_PADDING
regions.description: Byte offset 0x02C000: Padding aligning page slots to 64 KB boundary 0x030000.

regions.name: PAGE_SLOTS
regions.description: Byte offset 0x030000: Contiguous 4 KB buffer pool page slots (default 1024 slots = 4 MB).

regions.name: SLOT_TO_PAGE
regions.description: Byte offset 0x430000 (default 1024 slots): Array of uint32 pageIds mapping slot -> pageId.

regions.name: PAGE_TO_SLOT
regions.description: Byte offset 0x431000 (default 1024 slots): Open-addressing hash table mapping pageId -> slot.

regions.name: DIRTY_MASK
regions.description: Byte offset 0x435000 (default 1024 slots): Bitmask tracking dirty slots.

regions.name: ARENA_ALIGNMENT_PADDING
regions.description: Byte offset 0x435080 (default 1024 slots): Padding aligning transient arena to 64 KB boundary 0x440000.

bufferPool.endOffsetDescription: Byte offset 0x440000 (default 1024 slots): Start of dynamic transient query execution arena.

postConstants.name: TOTAL_MEMORY_BYTES
postConstants.description: Total buffer pool and shared Wasm memory allocation in bytes for default 1024 slots (20.25 MB).
